_doc: Interval fingerprints (semitones, transposition-free) of famous hooks our melodies must not resemble (docs/AUDIO.md §6.5). `min` = how many consecutive matching intervals count as a FAIL (default 6); `anchor` = the match must start at the hook's first interval (its signature opening). Reviewers add entries; keep them short, from memory of the published melody. Used by `studio.py originality`.
